title.narrative: Takhiatash Power Plant Efficiency Improvement Project

description.narrative: The project, to be implemented in the Takhiatash thermal power plant (TPP), involves building two combined-cycle gas turbine (CCGT) units, decommissioning old and inefficient power generation units, improving energy efficiency, and increasing power supply to the Karakalpakstan and Khorezm regions. It includes a capacity development component to improve corporate performance and a social development component to foster gender equality.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Increased energy-efficient power supply in Karakalpakstan and Khorezm regions

Takhiatash TPP gas consumption decreased from 1,117 million cubic meter (m3) (2011) to 799 million m3 by 2020 Achievement: 1208.43 Progress/Status: Target achievable. Data Source: Takhiatash TPP statistics
Takhiatash TPP GHG emission reduced from 2.1 mtCO2e (2011) to 1.7 mtCO2e by 2020 Achievement: 1.46 Progress/Status: Target achievable. Data Source: Takhiatash TPP statistics
Thermal efficiency of the new plant increased from 23.7% (2011) to 52% by 2020 Achievement: 52 Progress/Status: Target achievable. Data Source: Takhiatash TPP statistics
Power generated from Takhiatash TPP increased from 3,276 GWh (2011) to 3,896 GWh by 2020 Achievement: 4987 Progress/Status: Target achievable. Data Source: Takhiatash TPP statistics
Takhiatash TPP water consumption decreased from 453 million m3 (2011) to 51 million m3 by 2020 Achievement: 244.48 Progress/Status: Target achievable. Data Source: Takhiatash TPP statistics
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Community social service center becomes operational Indicator: At least 20 new jobs (50% of jobs created) in the community social service center are for women Achievement: 6 Progress/Status: 3.2. Target on job creation is achievable. At the present time (Q4 2022), the sewing workshop is functioning, with a staffing table of 14 units, of which more than 70% of jobs are occupied by women. Data Source: Takhiatash TPP statistics

Output: Energy-efficient power generators operational in Takhiatash TPP Indicator: 1.7 million m3 of hot water generated for the local community (including the community social service center) Achievement: 0.223 Progress/Status: 1.3. Hot water supply target is expected to be achieved with delay. However, this achievement may happen after the loan will be closed on 1 November 2022. Reason for the current underachievement appears to be due to supply of hot water based on the local town requests. During the past period many people have switched to the individual hot water and the central hot water supply. These are not covering as before. As a result, the local hot water company is requesting smaller amounts of hot water. Hence, hot water supply is based on the needs of the population. Data Source: Takhiatash TPP statistics

Output: Energy-efficient power generators operational in Takhiatash TPP Indicator: Two CCGT units with 230-280 MW each commissioned by 2018 Achievement: 560 Progress/Status: 1.1. Construction of two new CCGT units completed. Two CCGT units of 230-280 MW each were put into operation in 2021. Data Source: Commissioning certificate by Uzbekenergo

Output: Energy-efficient power generators operational in Takhiatash TPP Indicator: Existing three units (total 310 MW) decommissioned by 2020 Achievement: 0.0 Progress/Status: 1.2. Dismantling of old units was complete, demolishing of the respective buildings and facilities is ongoing. Expected completion date August 2023. Data Source: Decommissioning certificate by Uzbekenergo

Output: Community social service center becomes operational Indicator: Community social service center, equipped with dry-cleaning, laundry, and carpet-cleaning facilities, open to local community and TPP staff (50,000 people) Achievement: N Progress/Status: 3.1. The working group of the Takhiatash TPP together with the chairman of the women's committee of the Takhiatash district, on July 05, 2019, held meetings with residents of the Takhiatash and Kusshylyk makhallas and conducted a survey of the population about the construction of a social center. Based on the results of the survey and in the opinion of the local population, it was decided to build a diagnostic center and a sewing workshop. The construction of a diagnostic center and a sewing workshop was completed and put into operation in Q1 2022. Data Source: Commissioning certificate by Uzbekenergo Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Target year: 2018 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: Developed Uzbekenergo's capacity to become commercially bankable Indicator: Key performance indicator-based management sytem introduced by 2017 Achievement: N Progress/Status: 2.1. The component will be dropped/reconsidered due to unbundling of Uzbekenergo. Data Source: Uzbekenergo's annual performance reports Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: Developed Uzbekenergo's capacity to become commercially bankable Indicator: Tariff analysis and training completed for at least 30 staff (with at least 20% being women) by 2017 Achievement: Y Progress/Status: 2.2. Target achieved. Tariff analysis was conducted and workshop was held on 12 Sep 2018. Additional training module was developed on the analysis of the tariffication system and training was conducted among the employees of the Takhiatash TPP on February10, 2020. The training was conducted on the following concepts: • concept of the tariff for manufactured products • Tariff formation • The role of the tariff in production Data Source: Tariff analysis and training report by Uzbekenergo Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Developed Uzbekenergo's capacity to become commercially bankable Indicator: Uzbekenergo's risk profile assessment completed by 2018 Achievement: Y Progress/Status: 2.3. Target achieved. Data Source: Risk profile assessment report by Uzbekenergo Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Target year: 2018 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
